subject.title: feat(mobile): default pairing to full node access

question: Should official iOS and Android setup codes grant operator.admin by default, including its effective pairing authority, once the Limited downgrade path is made exact?
rationale: The code can enforce either policy, but choosing the default trust granted by a scanned setup credential is a product and security-boundary decision that tests cannot settle.

options.title: Approve full default after repair
options.body: Keep full access as the recommended default, but first force Limited codes to rotate or cap existing administrator tokens and document the effective authority.

options.title: Keep limited default
options.body: Preserve the current bounded credential as default and expose full access only through an explicit operator choice.

options.title: Pause for threat-model review
options.body: Hold the PR until the mobile bootstrap trust model and setup-code sharing assumptions are documented and approved.

recommendation.title: Approve full default after repair
recommendation.body: Keep full access as the recommended default, but first force Limited codes to rotate or cap existing administrator tokens and document the effective authority.
